attacks.name: Blades
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
If the target character has the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition, you may reroll two attack dice during this attack.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the Bleed special condition.

attacks.name: Headbutt
steps: |!wild| |*Stun|: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.
If the target character is Size 3 or less, after this attack is resolved, it may be pushed away from this character |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Titan Killer
steps: Add one die to this attack roll for every |!damage| token on this character.
|!wild| |*Throw|: Before damage is dealt, if the target character is Size 4 or less, this character may throw the target character away |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: The Destroyer
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of Size 3 or less and within |!range| 2, and throw it |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Driven by Vengeance
superPowers.body: When this character is damaged by an enemy attack, you may use this superpower. Place a |<vengeance>Vengeance| token on or move an existing Vengeance token to the enemy character that caused the effect. When this character targets a character that has a Vengeance token with an attack, this character rolls 3 additional attack dice. After this attack is resolved, the Vengeance token is removed. This character may have only one Vengeance token in play at a time.

superPowers.name: I Can Take It
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.
